name: io.github.syedanas01/mcp-safeguard
description: Security scanner for MCP servers — automatically detect prompt injection, credential leaks, SSRF vulnerabilities, and tool poisoning, plus endpoint and dangerous-port probes.

tools.name: scan_config
tools.description: Scan an MCP server configuration file for security vulnerabilities. Detects prompt injection, credential leaks, SSRF risks, and tool poisoning. Returns CVSS-scored findings with remediation guidance.

config_path.description: Path to the Claude Desktop or MCP config JSON file to scan

tools.name: scan_tools
tools.description: Scan raw MCP tool definitions for security vulnerabilities without a config file. Accepts a list of tool objects and returns findings.
Array of MCP tool definition objects with name, description, and inputSchema
